gate_evidence.G1: Bounded catalogue-type attribution with incomplete visual evidence.
gate_evidence.G2: The proposed questions concern learned recognition and decision errors.
gate_evidence.G3: Adaptation, fusion and acceptance heads can be trained.
gate_evidence.G4: No adequate existing local training/test corpus verified.
gate_evidence.G5: Existing exact-type labels may be too ambiguous without expert adjudication.
gate_evidence.G6: Narrow hypotheses proposed; novelty and baseline failure unverified.
gate_evidence.G7: The conditional plan includes model comparisons and ablations.
gate_evidence.G8: Specimen IDs, label coverage and held-out type counts require a data audit.
gate_evidence.G9: Data dependencies and baseline stability unresolved.
gate_evidence.G10: Proposed divisions need sufficient paired specimens and distinct empirical findings.
gate_evidence.G11: Compact encoders and cached features avoid a high-end compute dependency.
gate_evidence.G12: Source-specific terms exist; a permitted reproducible corpus has not been established.
gate_evidence.G13: Transfer failure, fixed-fusion parity and rare-type rejection are useful bounded results.
